# What is Standard Operating Procedure? (SOP)
SOP, in its most simplest form, is how Nanotrasen expects Command and Crew to run station facilities.
Deviations from SOP, while not a violation of space law, may be grounds for discipline and/or termination of contract. Given circumstances and context, Nanotrasen expects Command and Crew to prioritize safety the of Station and allows for flexibility in the following SOP. Non standard situation are not expected to be covered by a [bold]Standard[/bold] Operating Procedure. SOP can be adaptable if a situation requires.
The decision to punish a Crew for breach of SOP is decided by the relevant Head of Staff (And in the case of Captain, Central Command is the only authority to determine break of SOP and punishment).
Due to SOP being newly implemented in this sector, only Command members have explicit Nanotrasen created SOP's. At this current moment, Heads of Staff are permitted to create their own department based SOP's for non Command Crew and submit them to Central Command via fax.
